:::{#exr-null-gram-practice}
#### Finding the null space of a Gram matrix

@thm-null-gram lets the [null space](#def-null-space) of a [Gram matrix](#def-gram-matrix)
be read off from the original [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix).
Let $\matr{A}$ be the $3 \times 2$ matrix whose every entry is $1$.

Find $\mathcal{N}(\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A})$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find $\mathcal{N}(\matr{A})$ first.
Each entry of $\matr{A}\vecf{x}$ is $x_1 + x_2$.

:::
